message.content:
**Uno – Quick‑Start Rules** | Section | What you need to know | |---------|-----------------------| | **Goal** | Be the first player to score 500 points (or whatever house rule you set). Points are earned by being the first to empty your hand in each round. | | **Players** | 2–10 (standard deck). | | **Deck** | 108 cards: 4 colors (Red, Yellow, Green, Blue) × 25 cards each + 8 Wild cards. | | **Card Types** | 1. **Number cards** (0–9). 2. **Action cards**: Skip, Reverse, Draw Two. 3. **Wild cards**: Wild, Wild Draw Four. | | **Setup** | 1. Shuffle the deck. 2. Deal 7 cards to each player. 3. Place the remaining deck face‑down as the draw pile. 4. Flip the top card of the draw pile to start the discard pile. If it’s an action or wild card, follow its effect immediately (e.g., if it’s a Draw Two, the first player draws two cards and loses their turn). | | **Turn Order** | Players take turns clockwise (unless a Reverse card changes direction). | | **Playing a Card** | On your turn you may play **one** card that matches either the **color** or the **number/symbol** of the top discard. If you have a Wild card, you may play it at any time and declare the new color. | | **If You Can’t Play** | Draw one card from the draw pile. If that card can be played, you may play it immediately; otherwise, your turn ends. | | **Special Cards** | • **Skip** – Next player loses their turn.
• **Reverse** – Changes play direction.
• **Draw Two** – Next player draws two cards and loses their turn.
• **Wild** – You choose the new color.
• **Wild Draw Four** – You choose the new color; next player draws four cards and loses their turn. (Can only be played if you have no matching color; otherwise you risk a challenge.) | | **Calling “UNO”** | When you play your **second‑to‑last** card, you must shout “UNO!” If you forget and another player catches you before the next player takes a turn, you must draw two penalty cards. | | **Winning a Round** | The first player to discard all their cards wins the round. | | **Scoring** | Add up the point values of the cards left in opponents’ hands:
• Number cards = face value.
• Skip, Reverse, Draw Two = 20 points.
• Wild, Wild Draw Four = 50 points.
Winner of the round gets those points. | | **Game End** | First player to reach the target score (usually 500) wins the game. | --- ### Quick Tips 1. **Keep a Hand of Low‑Value Cards** – If you’re close to winning, try to keep low‑value cards to reduce your opponent’s potential points. 2. **Watch Opponents’ Colors** – If you see a player running out of a particular color, consider playing a Wild to force them to draw. 3. **Use Wild Draw Four Wisely** – It’s powerful but risky; only use it when you truly have no matching color. 4. **Challenge Rule** – If you suspect a player illegally played a Wild Draw Four, you can challenge. If they were right, you draw four; if they were wrong, you draw six. Enjoy the fast‑paced, colorful fun of Uno!
